architects:loader-monteith.name: Loader Monteith
paragraphs: Loader Monteith is an architecture practice in Glasgow, Scotland, founded in 2016 by Matt Loader and Iain Monteith. It designs new houses and works on existing and historic buildings, and its own site describes an approach built around conservation, heritage work and circular design: reusing materials, recycling construction waste and designing buildings that can be taken apart.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses across Scotland, from new family homes on farms and hillsides to extensions of listed and conservation-area cottages and townhouses. Each house links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Houses: new builds, extensions and conservation

edit.standfirst: A Glasgow practice, founded in 2016, working on new houses and on conservation and heritage buildings.

makers:byarums-bruk.name: Byarums Bruk
paragraphs: Byarums Bruk is a foundry and furniture maker in Byarum, Småland, Sweden, founded in 1947 by the Bokinge brothers. At a time when cast iron dominated, they chose to cast aluminium. In 1974 the second owner, Hans Pruth, took over with a vision of making furniture, and from the 1980s the company began developing its own models with the designer Björn Alge.

Today the range is mainly outdoor and public-space furniture: benches, tables, armchairs and sofas, plus planters, litter bins and bicycle bollards. The company says its products are made to stand outdoors in the Nordic climate, and that the material is melted down and reused when a product has served its time. It still works with outside designers.
facts: Outdoor and public-space furniture, planters, litter bins, bicycle bollards
Cast metal (aluminium named on their site)

edit.standfirst: A Småland foundry, founded in 1947, making cast outdoor furniture with named designers.

designers:hella-jongerius.name: Hella Jongerius
paragraphs: Hella Jongerius is a Dutch industrial designer who studied at the Design Academy Eindhoven. She founded Jongeriuslab in Rotterdam in 1993 and moved the studio to Berlin in 2008. The studio's own site describes her work as an open-ended research into colours, materials and textures, with finished and semi-finished products as part of a never-ending process.

It points to attention for imperfections, traces of how a piece was made and the potential of materials and techniques. On Formground she is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them vases, coffee tables, lounge chairs, plates and bottles. The studio's site lists projects, exhibitions and publications.
facts: Vases, coffee tables, lounge chairs, plates, bottles (as shown on Formground)
sources: Wikipedia: Hella Jongerius (founding, move to Berlin, training)

edit.standfirst: Jongeriuslab, founded in Rotterdam in 1993 and now in Berlin, researches colour, material and texture.

architects:innauer-matt-architekten.name: Innauer Matt Architekten
paragraphs: Innauer Matt Architekten is an architecture office in Bezau, in the Bregenzerwald in Austria, founded in 2012 by Markus Innauer and Sven Matt. Its own profile describes work that approaches each task close to the place, the landscape and the people who live there, and that joins what already exists with the new, aiming for a quiet, everyday kind of architecture.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, among them Haus Feurstein, Haus Fink and Berghaus Eller. Each house links to its project page on the office's own site.

edit.standfirst: An office in the Bregenzerwald, founded in 2012, building close to the place and the landscape.

architects:omar-gandhi-architect.name: Omar Gandhi Architect
paragraphs: Omar Gandhi Architect is a practice founded in 2010 by Omar Gandhi, with design studios in Toronto, Halifax and Berlin. Its own site describes a portfolio that ranges from homes and urban infill buildings to public works and historic landscapes, with designs based on the physical character of each site and the familiar architecture of the area, reworked into new forms.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, most of them in Nova Scotia, including the Rabbit Snare Gorge cabin in the Cape Breton Highlands and the Schlotfeldt Residence in British Columbia. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Halifax (studios also in Toronto and Berlin)

edit.standfirst: A practice founded in 2010 with studios in Toronto, Halifax and Berlin.

architects:wittman-estes.name: Wittman Estes
paragraphs: Wittman Estes is an architecture practice in Seattle that works together with landscape. Its own site says it began from the view that buildings and landscapes were being designed as separate things, and it sets out to design them as one, with smooth thresholds between inside and outside and a richness of natural materials. It describes itself as known for energy-positive prefab housing, multifamily housing and design for sensitive ecological sites.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, from courtyard houses in the city to cabins on islands and by rivers. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.

edit.standfirst: A Seattle practice that designs buildings and landscapes together.

makers:kristina-dam-studio.name: Kristina Dam Studio
paragraphs: Kristina Dam Studio is a Danish design studio with a showroom in Copenhagen, founded in 2012 by the graphic designer Kristina Dam. It began with a series of limited-edition illustrations and grew to include furniture, home textiles and sculptures. The studio describes its approach as "sculptural minimalism", joining an artist's attention to detail with an architect's vision.

Its furniture includes the Curved and Grid series, the Collector dining table and chair and the Outline series, and the studio says its oak furniture is made from solid FSC-certified oak. On Formground its work is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page on the studio's site.
facts: Solid FSC-certified oak (stated for its oak furniture)

edit.standfirst: A Copenhagen studio, founded in 2012, working in what it calls sculptural minimalism.

makers:garsnas.name: Gärsnäs
paragraphs: Gärsnäs is a family-owned furniture maker in Gärsnäs, in Österlen in Skåne, Sweden. The company says the carpenter Anders Andersson started the factory in 1893, and it is now run by the third generation of the Axelsson-Klockby family. The factory lies among red beech trees, and the company describes its chairs as a blend of woodworking skill and industrial production.

The range is mainly chairs, armchairs, stools and tables, with {count} pieces shown on Formground, each linked to its own page. The company says the modular construction of its chairs makes them easy to renovate.
facts: Wood (local beech named on their site)

edit.standfirst: A family-owned furniture maker in Skåne, started in 1893.

designers:pierre-charpin.name: Pierre Charpin
paragraphs: Pierre Charpin is a French designer, born in 1962 in Saint-Mandé near Paris, who graduated from the Beaux-Arts de Bourges in 1984. Since the early 1990s he has designed furniture and objects. His own site lists research projects with the glass centre CIRVA (1998 to 2001) and the fire and earth arts centre CRAFT (2003 to 2005), and collaborations with manufacturers including Alessi, Hermès, Ligne Roset and Venini.
He lives and works in Ivry-sur-Seine, near Paris. On Formground he is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them coffee tables, vases, mirrors and lighting.
facts: Coffee tables, vases, mirrors, lighting (as shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A French designer of furniture and objects, working near Paris since the early 1990s.

designers:konstantin-grcic.name: Konstantin Grcic
paragraphs: Konstantin Grcic (born 1965) trained as a cabinet maker at the John Makepeace School for Craftsmen in Wood before studying design at the Royal College of Art in London. He set up his own practice in 1991, and Konstantin Grcic Design is now based in Berlin, working on furniture, products and lighting as well as exhibition design and collaborations in architecture and fashion.
His own site lists producers including Magis, Vitra, Flos and Cassina. On Formground he is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them tables, benches, lounge chairs and lamps.
facts: Tables, benches, lounge chairs, lamps (as shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A designer trained as a cabinet maker, with his own practice since 1991.

architects:tham-videgard-arkitekter.name: Tham & Videgård Arkitekter
paragraphs: Tham & Videgård, written ThamVidegård on its own site, is an architecture office in Stockholm founded in 1999 by Bolle Tham and Martin Videgård. The site describes an experimental approach that has grown into a practice with global reach, names the Kasper Salin Prize from Sveriges Arkitekter for the Kalmar Museum of Art and the KTH School of Architecture, and lists exhibitions including the Venice Architecture Biennale and the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, almost all in and around Stockholm and its archipelago, among them Husarö, House V and the Archipelago House. Each links to its project page on the office's own site.

edit.standfirst: An experimental Stockholm office, founded in 1999, whose houses sit on the archipelago.

makers:davsjo.name: Davsjö
paragraphs: Davsjö is a Swedish maker of furniture and objects, led by the designer and founder David Sjöberg. Its own site describes furniture rooted in Scandinavian craftsmanship and made to last, with a process that starts from the question of what problem is being solved. It says it combines traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing, and that each piece is designed and made in its factory in Northern Sweden.

The range on Formground includes dining tables, folding dining chairs, bar stools, step ladders with wall mounts and ash cutlery, with {count} pieces shown, each linked to its own page. The company says the folding mechanism of its DS10 and DS11 dining chairs is built into the design.
facts: Dining tables, dining chairs, bar stools, step ladders, cutlery

edit.standfirst: A Swedish maker of ash furniture and objects, designed and made in Northern Sweden.

architects:welsh-major.name: Welsh + Major
paragraphs: Welsh + Major is an architecture practice in Sydney, established in 2004 by David Welsh and Chris Major, working across architecture, interiors, planning and urban design. Its own site calls its architects "modern-ish": a broad modernist sensibility that is not bound by the dogma of materials, and that responds to programme and context rather than reacting to them.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, most of them in New South Wales, among them Seagrass House, Annandale House and Twin Set. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Architecture, interiors, planning and urban design (houses shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A Sydney practice, established in 2004, that calls itself modern-ish.

makers:sizar-alexis.name: Sizar Alexis
paragraphs: Sizar Alexis is an Iraqi-born, Sweden-based designer who makes objects and sculptural furniture in geometric forms. Born in Ankawa, near Erbil in northern Iraq, he moved to Sweden with his family in 1997 and settled in Eskilstuna. He studied at Beckmans College of Design and holds degrees in engineering (2009) and fine arts (2019).

His own site says the work explores the raw beauty of natural materials and draws on the architectural and spiritual heritage of ancient Mesopotamia and his Chaldean background. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Lahmu coffee table, the Ousia and Ode chairs and the Pilier console.

edit.standfirst: An Iraqi-born, Sweden-based designer making sculptural furniture and objects in geometric forms.

architects:stra-arkitekter.name: STRÅ arkitekter
paragraphs: STRÅ is an Oslo-based architecture practice working in architecture and urban design, established in 2021 and directed by Anders Byng Strøm and Gustav Jerlvall Jeppsson. Its own site says the work ranges from bespoke vacation homes and villas to large buildings, public spaces and strategic planning, rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition and marked by "both rigor and playfulness". The office sits in a storefront space in Majorstua, shared with a small coworking community.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, among them Knarrvika, Villa Sandnes and Strandhuset. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Architecture and urban design (houses shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: An Oslo practice, established in 2021, designing vacation homes, villas and public buildings.

makers:mabeo-furniture.name: Mabeo Furniture
paragraphs: Mabeo is a furniture maker in Botswana that began by making furniture for commercial projects. Its own site describes a move to making simple objects through a hands-on dialogue with artisans and craftspeople in Botswana, working with international designers including Patricia Urquiola, Vincent Van Duysen and Claesson Koivisto Rune.

The Lesire collection, designed by Mabeo Studio, is made in Panga Panga wood that the site says comes from a community environmental preservation project in neighbouring Mozambique. On Formground the maker is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Kika stool, the Embi series and the Tswana folding chair.
facts: Wood, including Panga Panga (stated for the Lesire collection)

edit.standfirst: A furniture maker in Botswana working with local craftspeople and international designers.

makers:another-country.name: Another Country
paragraphs: Another Country is a company founded in 2010 that designs and makes contemporary wood furniture and home accessories in the UK and Portugal. Its own site says its designs draw on archetype, from British country kitchen style, Shaker and traditional Scandinavian and Japanese woodwork, and that its wooden products are made from sustainable timbers.

Most of its numbered furniture series are designed in-house, and it also works with outside designers, including David Irwin (the Hardy Collection) and Ian McIntyre (the Pottery Series). On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

edit.standfirst: A UK furniture company, founded in 2010, making contemporary wood furniture in the UK and Portugal.

makers:fogia.name: Fogia
paragraphs: Fogia is a Swedish furniture maker that says craftsmanship, material knowledge and close collaboration between designers and makers have shaped its work since 1981. Its own factory has wood workshops and studios for upholstery, cutting and sewing, which it says lets ideas be tested and refined close to production. It describes its approach as function and friction: a piece needs both.

It has showrooms in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Oslo, with its flagship store in Stockholm. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from sofas and lounge chairs to tables, shelves and lighting, each linked to its own page.
facts: 1981 (stated as the start of its way of working)

makers:mokko-amsterdam.name: Mokko Amsterdam
paragraphs: Mokko is an Amsterdam-based design studio founded in 2017 and led by the designer Aad Bos. Its own site describes furniture and objects with a sculptural presence, drawn from archetypal forms, volumes and voids, and made to be used, cared for and repaired over generations.

Every piece is made to order by artisans in the Netherlands, and the site says its solid wood comes from responsibly managed forests. The collection is shown in its Amsterdam showroom and in selected showrooms and galleries abroad, including Boon Room in Paris and Love House in New York. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.
facts: Solid wood from responsibly managed forests (stated on their site)

makers:ed-heritage.name: Ed Heritage
paragraphs: Ed Heritage is a UK design studio led by its founder, Ed, a product and furniture designer with a background in architecture and an MA from Kingston School of Art. Its own site says the work explores how design can deepen the emotional connection between people and objects, using clean geometry, playful interaction and a balance of form, function and material.

Its one product on Formground is the TILT lamp, a rechargeable table lamp that switches on and off when you tilt it, made of solid FSC-certified European ash, glass and metal. The site says it is designed in the UK and made in the PRC, and lists stockists in the UK and Japan.
facts: Solid FSC-certified European ash, glass, metal

makers:host-toast.name: Host & Toast
paragraphs: Host & Toast is a design and fabrication studio that makes furniture, objects and custom builds. Its own site says that since 2013 it has designed and built custom interiors, event installations and furniture by hand, and describes its work as grounded in brand alignment, material honesty and deliberate restraint, favouring longevity over trends.

Its online shop offers a selection of furniture and objects, among them the Eld chair, the Pinstripe side table and the Sill credenza, with {count} pieces shown on Formground, each linked to its own page. It also invites interior designers, architects and trade professionals to ask about consultations, pricing and lead times.

makers:20by8.name: 20by8
paragraphs: 20by8, also written Twentybyeight, is a small workshop run by Sergei Grigorev, a designer based in Cyprus who worked for many years as an interior designer. His own site says he makes chairs, mostly, by hand in small batches, with a focus on high-end craftsmanship, distinctive design and premium materials.

He describes taking responsibility for the whole process, from the first sketch to the last stitch, and finding the balance between design and craft as what interests him most. On Formground the workshop is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Fourth chair, the Eero chair and the Stauros armchair; prices are given on request through an inquiry form.
facts: Oak, walnut and leather (as shown on their pages)

designers:space-copenhagen.name: Space Copenhagen
paragraphs: Space Copenhagen is a design studio in Copenhagen, founded in 2005 by Signe Bindslev Henriksen and Peter Bundgaard Rützou. Its own site says it works across interior design for homes, hotels and restaurants worldwide, art installations and art direction, furniture, lighting and refined objects, and calls its approach Poetic Modernism: balancing opposites such as classic and modern, industrial and organic, sculptural and minimal.

The site names interiors including the 11 Howard hotel in New York and the restaurants Geranium and the first Noma in Copenhagen, and manufacturers it designs for, among them GUBI, Fredericia, &Tradition and Mater. On Formground it is credited on {count} pieces.

architects:sanden-hodnekvam-architects.name: Sanden+Hodnekvam Architects
paragraphs: Sanden+Hodnekvam Architects is an architecture studio founded in 2014 by John Sanden and Ingvild Hodnekvam, based in Oslo and Nesodden in Norway. Its own site says the work balances simplicity of form with richness in tectonics and atmosphere, seeking rational, aesthetic and sustainable solutions with honesty of materials and construction.

The site says the studio is one of six selected for Norway's national scenic route programme 2022 to 2029, and that its work has been nominated for the European Union Prize for Contemporary Architecture, the Mies van der Rohe Award. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

makers:vikens-hantverkeri.name: Vikens Hantverkeri
paragraphs: Vikens Hantverkeri is a Swedish maker of tables on Lidingö, near Stockholm. Its own site describes tables made to measure in marble and wood, and says it offers more than 50 kinds of marble, depending on what the quarries supply, and a wide choice of woods and finishes. It invites customers to design their own table, or to ask for a wood it does not list.

On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from dining and coffee tables to a desk, a bar table and a shelf, each linked to its own page. Prices on its site start from the lowest configuration, with size and material chosen when ordering.
facts: Tables, a desk, a shelf, a wine rack
Yes (made to measure, stated on their site)
